name: Shiko
description: Commander of the Jeskai Striker deck.

description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm/Commander". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Illusory spirit dragons fly overhead as Narset reflects on each clan's dragon and on her lack of love for Shiko.
timeline.quote: But she didn't love Shiko, no, not with those wings of hers, like so many scrolls unfurling through the air

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset stops the quarrel and tells how the dragons were unformed and she first leapt onto one, binding herself to Shiko; they rode into battle and drove the dragonlords into the storm.
timeline.quote: I was the first to leap onto one.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The khans perform the ritual at the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, raising five spirit dragons bound to them.
timeline.quote: Narset shaped the first into Shiko

citation.text: "Stormnexus Ritual", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: bound to the spirit dragon she called from the ritual
relations.quote: the spirit dragon whom she'd called from the ritual, whom she'd ridden into battle against the dragonlords
